newsitem.title: USA: Smart & Final to acquire 91 stores.
newsitem.headline: Smart & Final to acquire 91 stores.

text.p: Smart & Final Inc said on Tuesday that it reached an agreement in principle to acquire 91 store facilities and several other properties used in its operations from Casino USA Inc and Casino Realty Inc.
The $76 million acquisition will consist of half of the purchase price in Smart & Final stock and the remainder in five-year unsecured notes.
The company said the property purchase is expected to be completed by the end of the year and is subject to the approval of shareholders and any governmental entities.

Smart and Final said the transaction is also expected to be accretive, increasing the company's earnings per share. "The acquisition of the operating properties is expected to be very positive for the company's continued growth," Roger Laverty, president and chief executive said in a statement. "It gives Smart & Final better control of its store properties and the flexibility to relocate stores when opportunities arise," he said.
